<!-- head-1: body_md -->
\emph{The JCAS CP $\mathcal{P}_{cs}(\theta_c, \theta_s)$, is defined as the probability that the received SIR of the communication and sensing functions at the BS are simultaneously not less than predefined thresholds $\theta_c$ and $\theta_s$, respectively, required for successful communication and tracking, i.e., $\mathcal{P}_{cs}(\theta_c, \theta_s)  \triangleq \mathbb{P}[ {\rm{SIR}}_{c}>\theta_c, {\rm{SIR}}_s>\theta_s]$. }
<!-- end head-1 -->
<!-- head-2: body_md -->
\emph{The joint PDF $f_{\mathbf{w}_i}(x_i,y_i,z_i)$ is given by }
\begin{equation}
f_{\mathbf{w}_i}(x_i,y_i,z_i) = \frac{1}{|\mathcal{C}(L,R)|},
\end{equation}
\emph{where $|\mathcal{C}(L,R)|=\pi R^2L$ and $x_i \in[-L/2, L/2]$, $y_i \in\big[-\sqrt{R^2-(z-h)^2}, \sqrt{R^2-(z-h)^2}\big]$ and $z_i\in [h-R,h+R]$.}
<!-- end head-2 -->
<!-- head-3: body_md -->
Since the UAV-UE locations form a uniform BPP in the finite cylindrical corridor \(\mathcal{C}(L,R)\), each UAV-UE location \(\mathbf{w}_i=(x_i,y_i,z_i)\) is independently and uniformly distributed over \(\mathcal{C}(L,R)\). Therefore, its joint spatial PDF is
\begin{equation} \label{eq_proof1}
    f_{\mathbf{w}_i}(x_i,y_i,z_i) = \frac{1}{|\mathcal{C}(L,R)|}, 
\end{equation}
where the corridor is defined as $\mathcal{C} = \big\{(x_i,y_i,z_i): x \in [-\frac{L}{2},\frac{L}{2}] ,\quad y^2+(z-h)^2\leq R^2\big\}$. By solving the inequality in \eqref{eq_proof1} for $y$ given a $z$ value, it yields $y^2 \leq  R^2 -(z-h)^2  \rightarrow |y| \leq \sqrt{R^2 -(z-h)^2}$ from which the final range of $y$ is obtained. Next, the restriction \(R^2-(z-h)^2 \geq 0\) gives
\(|z-h|\leq R\), from which the range of \(z\) follows as in Lemma~1. \null\nobreak\hfill\ensuremath{\blacksquare}
<!-- end head-3 -->
<!-- head-4: body_md -->
\emph{Conditioned on the location  $\mathbf{w}_0$ of the tracked UAV-UE and the misalignment error $\mathbf{\epsilon}$, the conditional Laplace transform  $\mathcal{L}_{I_s}(s|\mathbf{w}_0)$ of the aggregate clutter interference power distribution is given by}
\begin{align}
&\mathcal{L}_{I_s}(s|\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon}) = \Big[  \int_{0}^{\infty} \int_{\mathcal{C}} \sum_{t \in  \{L,N\} } \frac{1}{\Big(1+\frac{s  \sigma_i g_{{\rm{mis}}}^{\boldsymbol{\epsilon}}(\mathbf{w}_i|\mathbf{w}_0)^2 }{m_t l^{-2}(\mathbf{w}_i)}\Big)^{m_t}} \\
& \times P_t(\mathbf{w}_i) f_{\mathbf{w}_i}(\mathbf{w}_i) f_{\sigma_i}(\sigma_i) {\rm{d}} \mathbf{w}_i {\rm{d}} \sigma_i\Big]^{N-1}, \nonumber 
\end{align} 
\emph{where $g_{{\rm{mis}}}^{\boldsymbol{\epsilon}}(\mathbf{w}_i|\mathbf{w}_0) = g_{{\rm{mis}}}^{\boldsymbol{\epsilon}}(\theta_i, \theta_{0},\phi_i,\phi_{0})$ and the angles in $g_{{\rm{mis}}}^{\boldsymbol{\epsilon}}(\theta_i, \theta_{0},\phi_i,\phi_{0})$  are given by $\phi_i=\rm{atan2}(y_i,x_i),\phi_0=\rm{atan2}(y_0,x_0), \theta_i = \tan^{-1}\big(\sqrt{x_i^2+y_i^2}/z_i\big),\theta_0 = \tan^{-1}\big(\sqrt{x_0^2+y_0^2}/z_0\big)$ and {\rm{atan2}} denotes the four quadrant arctan function \cite{press2007numerical}.}
<!-- end head-4 -->
<!-- head-5: body_md -->
See Appendix A. \null\nobreak\hfill\ensuremath{\blacksquare}
<!-- end head-5 -->
<!-- head-6: body_md -->
\emph{The conditional sensing CP $\mathcal{P}_{s}(\theta_s|\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon},t)$ of the  terrestrial BS is given by}
\begin{equation} 
\begin{split}
&\mathcal{P}_{s}(\theta_s|\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon},t) =\int_{0}^{\infty} \sum_{k=0}^{m_t - 1}  \frac{{(-s_0(\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon}))}^k }{ k!} \\
& \times{\Bigg[ \frac{\partial^{k} \mathcal{L}_{I_s}(s|\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon})}{\partial{s^k}}\Bigg]}_{s=s_0(\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon})} f_{\sigma_0}(\sigma_0) {\rm{d}}  \sigma_0, 
\end{split}
\end{equation}
\emph{for $s_0(\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon}) = \frac{m_t \theta_s}{\sigma_0 g_{{\rm{mis}}}^{\boldsymbol{\epsilon}}(\theta_0,\phi_0)^2l^2(\mathbf{w}_0)}$, $t \in \{L,N\}$ and $\theta_0,\phi_0$ given by Lemma 2}.
<!-- end head-6 -->
<!-- head-7: body_md -->
Due to page limitation, only the sketch of the proof is provided. Conditioned on $\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon},c$, the proof for deriving Proposition 1 follows conceptual lines similar to those presented in \cite{TWC}. Finally, since the RCS of the target UAV-UE $\sigma_0$ is independent of the aggregate clutter interference, averaging over its PDF $f_{\sigma_0}(\sigma_0)$ yields Proposition 1.  \null\nobreak\hfill\ensuremath{\blacksquare}
<!-- end head-7 -->
<!-- head-8: body_md -->
\emph{Conditioned on the location  $\mathbf{w}_0$ of the tracked UAV-UE and the misalignment error $\mathbf{\epsilon}$, the  Laplace transform  $\mathcal{L}_{I_c}(s|\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon})$ of the aggregate interference power distribution is given by}
\begin{align}
&\mathcal{L}_{I_c}(s|\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon}) = \Big[   \int_{\mathcal{C}} \sum_{t \in  \{L,N\} } \Big(1+\frac{s   g_{{\rm{mis}}}^{\boldsymbol{\epsilon}}(\mathbf{w}_i|\mathbf{w}_0)^2 }{m_t l^{-2}(\mathbf{w}_i)}\Big)^{-m_t} \\
& \times P_t(\mathbf{w}_i) f_{\mathbf{w}_i}(\mathbf{w}_i)  {\rm{d}} \mathbf{w}_i \Big]^{N-1}. \nonumber 
\end{align}
<!-- end head-8 -->
<!-- head-9: body_md -->
The proof for deriving Lemma 3 follows similar conceptual lines as the proof for deriving Lemma 2 and hence it is omitted here for brevity. \null\nobreak\hfill\ensuremath{\blacksquare}
<!-- end head-9 -->
<!-- head-10: body_md -->
\emph{The conditional communication CP $\mathcal{P}_{c}(\theta_c|\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon},t)$ of the  terrestrial BS is given by}
\begin{equation} 
\begin{split}
&\mathcal{P}_{c}(\theta_c|\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon},t) = \sum_{k=0}^{m_t - 1}  \frac{{(-s_0(\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon}))}^k }{ k!} \\
&\times {\Bigg[ \frac{\partial^{k} \mathcal{L}_{I_c}(s|\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon})}{\partial{s^k}}\Bigg]}_{s=s_0(\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon})} \, 
\end{split}
\end{equation}
\emph{for $s_0(\mathbf{w}_0,\mathbf{\epsilon}) = \frac{m_t \theta_c}{\ g_{{\rm{mis}}}^{\boldsymbol{\epsilon}}(\theta_0,\phi_0)^2l^2(\mathbf{w}_0)}$, $t \in \{L,N\}$ and $\theta_0,\phi_0$ given by Lemma 2}.
<!-- end head-10 -->
<!-- head-11: body_md -->
The proof for deriving Proposition 2 follows similar conceptual lines as the proof for deriving Proposition 1 and hence it is omitted here for brevity. \null\nobreak\hfill\ensuremath{\blacksquare}
<!-- end head-11 -->
<!-- head-12: body_md -->
\emph{The JCAS CP of a terrestrial BS in a UAV corridor-assisted network is given by}
\begin{align} 
 &\mathcal{P}_{cs}(\theta_c, \theta_s) \\\nonumber 
 &=  \int_{\mathcal{C}}  \iint_{\boldsymbol{\epsilon}}  \sum_{t \in \{L,N\}} P_t(\mathbf{w}_0) \mathcal{P}_{c} (\theta_c|\mathbf{w}_0,\boldsymbol{\epsilon},t)  \mathcal{P}_{s}(\theta_s|\mathbf{w}_0,\boldsymbol{\epsilon},t) \\\nonumber
 &\times f_{\mathbf{w}_0}(\mathbf{w}_0)f_{\boldsymbol{\epsilon}}(\boldsymbol{\epsilon}) {\rm{d}} \mathbf{w}_0  {\rm{d}} \boldsymbol{\epsilon}. \nonumber
\end{align}
<!-- end head-12 -->
<!-- head-13: body_md -->
See Appendix B. \null\nobreak\hfill\ensuremath{\blacksquare}
<!-- end head-13 -->
